%A Indriyani, Yuri %A Susiana, Susiana %A Rochmady, Rochmady %D 2020 %T Length-weight relationship and condition factors of Rabbitfish ( Siganus guttatus , Bloch 1787) in Sei Carang Waters, Tanjungpinang City, Indonesia %B 2020 %9 <i>Siganus guttatus</i>; Isometric; Growth pattern; Riau Islands %! Length-weight relationship and condition factors of Rabbitfish ( Siganus guttatus , Bloch 1787) in Sei Carang Waters, Tanjungpinang City, Indonesia %K <i>Siganus guttatus</i>; Isometric; Growth pattern; Riau Islands %X Sei Carang waters are baronang fish habitat ( Siganus guttatus ). The research was to determine the length-weight correlationship and condition factors of baronang fish ( S. guttatus ) in Sei  Carang. Sampling of baronang fish ( S. guttatus ) in two months (September-Oktober 2019) is taken once a week based on fishing activities and water conditions. Length-weight correlationship of female and male baronang fish ( S. guttatus ) were W = 2,0895E-05L 2,9575 and W = 1,30073E-05L 3,0424  respectively, based on this value show that female and male baronang fish ( S. guttatus ) in Sei Carang have isometric growth patterns (b = 3). Condition factors of female and male baronang fish ( S. guttatus ) were 1,735 and 1,633 respectively. %U https://journals.sangia.org/AGRIKAN/article/view/434 %0 Journal Article %R 10.29239/j.agrikan.13.2.327-333 %& 327 %P 7 %J Agrikan: Jurnal Agribisnis Perikanan %V 13 %N 2 %@ 2621-0193 %8 2020-11-10 %7 2020-12-03
